messages:
maria: Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure listing: trial SKU + co-marketing promo. Need a checklist to enable a 30-day trial entitlement and coordinate co-marketing assets. Who owns legal signoff and marketplace trial SKU activation? 

sam: I can own SKU activation on AWS + GCP. Need legal-approved trial terms (no auto-renew surprises). Also need SKU mapping doc from product. 

tess: @maria @sam I'm drafting trial T&Cs now. Can you paste the proposed trial language and exact limits? ETA EOD Tue. 

alex: Proposed trial language (draft):
```json
{"trial_length_days":30, "seats":10, "auto_convert":false, "usage_limits":{"tokens_per_month":500000}}
```
Also: map paid plans -> marketplace SKUs as: "Starter" -> sku.starter.marketplace, "Pro" -> sku.pro.marketplace. 

mike: Azure note: Azure requires an Offer Plan manifest and a separate trial flag in the plan JSON. I can upload once we have legal doc + marketing assets (logos/screenshots). Azure also needs a short description for the offer listing (<= 250 chars). 

emily: I have hero banners, 1-pager, and a short customer-facing blurb. I'll upload a compressed bundle: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/azure-trial-assets.zip — will include alt copy for GCP/AWS variants. 

deploy-bot: Offer submitted to AWS staging (offer-id: oc-12345) — awaiting admin approval. 

sam: For pricing mapping: remember marketplace plan prices need to match our billing SKU and show tax/currency mapping. @alex can you confirm decimal rounding rules + billing unit (per-token vs per-seat)? 

alex: Billing unit will be per-seat-month for trial -> convert to per-token in product docs. Rounding: marketplace requires 2 decimal places; we will translate on our side. I'll update the SKU mapping doc by EOD. 

tess: Once I sign off, legal will provide the trial addendum to attach to each marketplace listing. Need final asset bundle and the short description by tomorrow 9am PT. 

maria: Ok — action items:
- sam: finish AWS/GCP activation + confirm staging link
- mike: prep Azure offer manifest
- emily: upload assets bundle (link above)
- alex: update SKU mapping + pricing rounding
- tess: finalize T&Cs addendum
Meeting: sync tomorrow 9am PT to verify uploads and kick off co-marketing. 

sam: noted. I'll post staging URLs in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
